message.content:
Based on the screenshot of the **KozyCare members portal** (kozycare.ng/portal), here is a detailed description:

### 1. Page Layout (Top to Bottom)

*   **Browser Header:** The top of the screen shows a standard browser interface with multiple tabs open (Zai, Service, Kozy, etc.), the address bar displaying **`kozycare.ng/portal`**, and standard window controls.
*   **Main Content Card:** The central focus is a single, large white card with rounded corners and a subtle shadow, centered on a light gray background. This card contains all the membership and payment information.
    *   **Top Section (Status & Headline):** 
        *   Top-left: A small label in gold/brown text reads **"ALMOST IN THE CIRCLE"**.
        *   Top-right: A pill-shaped badge with a light yellow background and dark text reads **"Awaiting payment"**.
        *   Below this is the main headline in bold: **"Complete your first payment"**.
    *   **Informational Text:** A paragraph explains that 4 Kozy Box pickups start once the first month is paid, mentioning payment by transfer or card, and notes that 3/6/12-month rates are available.
    *   **Pricing Section:** Labeled **"YOUR FIRST MONTH"**, it displays the cost **"₦50,000"** in bold, followed by the text *"one month · then the kinder 3/6/12-month rates open in this card"*.
    *   **Payment Action Buttons:** Two large, rounded buttons are placed side-by-side:
        *   Left button: Light beige/gold color.
        *   Right button: Dark navy blue/black color.
    *   **Status Note:** A line of smaller gray text below the buttons states: *"Card payments are not configured yet — bank transfer works today; your membership activates the moment the office confirms."*
    *   **Bank Transfer Details Box:** A secondary box with a light cream/yellow background contains the specific transfer instructions.
    *   **Footer Notes:** Two final paragraphs of text at the bottom of the card provide information about future renewals and adding a second box.

### 2. Exact Text Quotes

*   **Status Badges/Headlines:**
    *   "ALMOST IN THE CIRCLE"
    *   "Awaiting payment"
    *   "Complete your first payment"
*   **Descriptive Text:**
    *   "Your 4 × Kozy Box pickups start the moment your first month is paid — and your rider schedules the Kozy Box hand-over. Pay by transfer below (or by card when it is available); the 3/6/12-month kinder rates open right ofer." *(Note: "ofer" appears to be a typo for "after")*
    *   "YOUR FIRST MONTH"
*   **Amounts:**
    *   "**₦50,000**" (Includes the Naira symbol ₦ and a comma as a thousands separator)
    *   "Pay **₦50,000** by card" (On the button)
    *   "Transfer **₦50,000**" (Inside the bank details box)
    *   "Send **50000**" (In the instruction line; note this one lacks the Naira symbol and comma)
*   **Bank Transfer Instructions (inside the cream box):**
    *   "Transfer ₦50,000"
    *   "Bank: **MoniePoint MicroFinance Bank**"
    *   "Account name: **Lake-Nuwa Investment**"
    *   "Account number: **4929540910**"
    *   "Reference: **KZY-RENEW-BF30HDRQ**"
    *   "Send 50000 with reference KZY-RENEW-BF30HDRQ — your membership activates the moment the office confirms it. You can also reply to your summary email with the receipt."
*   **Other Text:**
    *   "Card payments are not configured yet — bank transfer works today; your membership activates the moment the office confirms."
    *   "Once your first month is in, the standing ladder takes over — the longer you cover, the kinder the rate, always."
    *   "Need a second Kozy Box for the busy weeks? Reply to your summary email or call +234 803 175 5230 — we'll add it to your renewal."

### 3. Payment Buttons Description

There are two primary payment action buttons located in the middle of the card:

1.  **Left Button ("Pay by card"):**
    *   **Color:** Light beige or pale gold background with dark gray/black text.
    *   **Icon:** Features a small credit card icon on the left side of the text.
    *   **Text:** "Pay ₦50,000 by card"
    *   **Position:** Left side of the button row.

2.  **Right Button ("Pay by bank transfer"):**
    *   **Color:** Dark navy blue or charcoal black background with white text.
    *   **Icon:** Features a small bank/building icon (classical facade) on the left side of the text.
    *   **Text:** "Pay by bank transfer"
    *   **Position:** Right side of the button row.

*(Note: Based on the text "Card payments are not configured yet," the left button may be disabled or non-functional, directing users to use the right-hand bank transfer option.)*
